# Retry Configuration

<!-- status autogenerated section -->
<!-- end autogenerated section -->

This package defines configuration for retrying batches in case of export failure.

<!-- config autogenerated section -->
## Exported configs

### <a id="exported_configs.back_off_config"></a>back_off_config
| Setting | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| ------- | ---- | ------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `enabled` | bool | true | no | Indicates whether to retry sending batches in case of export failure. |
| `initial_interval` | duration | 5s | no | The time to wait after the first failure before retrying; ignored if enabled is false. |
| `max_elapsed_time` | duration | 5m | no | The maximum amount of time (including retries) spent trying to send a request/batch; ignored if enabled is false. Once this value is reached, the data is discarded. If set to 0, the retries are never stopped. |
| `max_interval` | duration | 30s | no | The upper bound on backoff interval; ignored if enabled is false. Once this value is reached the delay between consecutive retries will always be `MaxInterval`. |
| `multiplier` | float64 | 1.5 | no | The factor by which the backoff interval bounds are multiplied on each attempt; ignored if enabled is false. |
| `randomization_factor` | float64 | 0.5 | no | A random factor between 0 and 1 used to calculate next backoffs (randomized interval = RetryInterval * (1 ± RandomizationFactor)); ignored if enabled is false. |
<!-- end config autogenerated section -->
